_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Shadow of the Beast#000.src: Talk to Dereg in his house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Shadow of the Beast#000.dst: Поговори с Dereg в его доме на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#001.src: Oh, you look tough. You must be one of those humans I keep hearing about, right? People talk about your kind all the time.
The Shadow of the Beast#001.dst: Ого, вид у тебя боевой. Ты ведь из тех людей, о ком все твердят? О вас тут вечно болтают.
The Shadow of the Beast#001.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#002.src: You know, that you're all scrappers. Tough as nails, and willing to kill all sorts of beasts, you know?
The Shadow of the Beast#002.dst: Ну, что вы все драчуны. Крепкие, как гвозди, и готовы убить любого зверя, понимаешь?
The Shadow of the Beast#002.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#003.src: I think you know what I'm getting at. I saw some massive thing lumbering around the swamp one night! Tall as the trees, it was.
The Shadow of the Beast#003.dst: Думаю, ясно, к чему я клоню. Как-то ночью я видел, как по болоту бродит огромная тварь! Ростом с деревья!
The Shadow of the Beast#003.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#004.src: I couldn't make out the details, but if its size was any indication, it could just step over the {p} walls and wreck the whole town!
The Shadow of the Beast#004.dst: Толком не разглядел, но с таким ростом она запросто перешагнёт стены {p} и разнесёт весь город!
The Shadow of the Beast#004.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#005.src: Of course, there's so many scam artists around here trying to sell anti-monster underwear or whatever that no one believes me.
The Shadow of the Beast#005.dst: Только тут столько жуликов, что продают бельё от монстров и прочее, что мне никто не верит.
The Shadow of the Beast#005.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#006.src: So, that means it's up to you! Ehm, supposing that you're willing to help out, at least... The one thing I know for sure is that it was eating something.
The Shadow of the Beast#006.dst: Так что вся надежда на тебя! Эм, если, конечно, поможешь... Одно знаю точно: оно что-то ело.
The Shadow of the Beast#006.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#007.src: See that blood on the ground? That stuff is fresh. Follow it, see where it leads, and hunt that beast before it does something terrible!
The Shadow of the Beast#007.dst: Видишь кровь на земле? Свежая. Иди по следу, узнай, куда он ведёт, и убей зверя, пока он не натворил бед!
The Shadow of the Beast#007.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#008.src: That blood trail ought to lead you to wherever the beast went. Hunt that thing down for us all!
The Shadow of the Beast#008.dst: Кровавый след приведёт тебя туда, куда ушёл зверь. Выследи эту тварь ради всех нас!
The Shadow of the Beast#008.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#009.src: Follow the trail of blood left by the beast.

The Shadow of the Beast#010.src: Oh, this is such a mess! And my axe is busted, too...how am I going to get this fixed?!
The Shadow of the Beast#010.dst: Ох, ну и бардак! И топор сломан... как мне всё это починить?!
The Shadow of the Beast#010.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#011.src: I can't pay for- AAAH! H-Human! What do you want?! Not a good time!
The Shadow of the Beast#011.dst: Мне не заплатить за- А-А-А! Ч-человек! Чего тебе?! Не до тебя!
The Shadow of the Beast#011.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#012.src: Something destroyed my cow pen and wrecked up my entire farm!
The Shadow of the Beast#012.dst: Что-то снесло мой коровий загон и разнесло всю ферму!
The Shadow of the Beast#012.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#013.src: And they were solid, good-quality Willow, too...uff...
The Shadow of the Beast#013.dst: А ведь это была крепкая, добротная Willow... эх...
The Shadow of the Beast#013.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#014.src: Wait, what? You're hunting the thing? Well, that's fine and dandy, but do you think you could help here first?
The Shadow of the Beast#014.dst: Стой, что? Ты охотишься на эту тварь? Ну и славно, но, может, сперва поможешь мне тут?
The Shadow of the Beast#014.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#015.src: I have an idea of where it went, so...you scratch my back, I scratch yours?
The Shadow of the Beast#015.dst: Я примерно знаю, куда оно ушло, так что... услуга за услугу?
The Shadow of the Beast#015.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#016.src: Okay, this can work, this can work! I have to figure out how to fix this, and some of my cows ran off in a panic.
The Shadow of the Beast#016.dst: Так, сработает, сработает! Надо придумать, как всё починить, а часть коров в панике сбежала.
The Shadow of the Beast#016.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#017.src: So, you can take care of them while I re-plan my fencing. Simple enough, right?
The Shadow of the Beast#017.dst: Займись ими, пока я перестраиваю забор. Проще некуда, да?
The Shadow of the Beast#017.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#018.src: Three of my cows ran off. Look around the farm for them. They were eating, so look for fallen wheat on the ground!
The Shadow of the Beast#018.dst: Три коровы сбежали. Поищи их у фермы. Они ели, так что ищи рассыпанную пшеницу на земле!
The Shadow of the Beast#018.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#019.src: Go on, hop to it! I'm waiting for you right here!
The Shadow of the Beast#019.dst: Давай, живо! Я жду тебя прямо тут!
The Shadow of the Beast#019.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#020.src: Deal with the three escaped cows near the house and in the cave under the farm.
The Shadow of the Beast#020.dst: Разберись с тремя сбежавшими коровами у дома и в пещере под фермой.

The Shadow of the Beast#021.src: Oh, back aleady? I haven't even finished my stuff, where are the cows?
The Shadow of the Beast#021.dst: О, уже назад? Я ещё своё не доделал, а где коровы?
The Shadow of the Beast#021.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#023.src: ...eheh. You. You're. This is a joke, right? We're having a chuckle?!
The Shadow of the Beast#023.dst: ...хе-хе. Ты. Ты что. Это шутка, да? Мы же смеёмся?!
The Shadow of the Beast#023.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#024.src: WE'RE JOKING, RIGHT?! FOR THE LOVE OF ALL THAT'S HOLY TELL ME THIS IS A JOKE!
The Shadow of the Beast#024.dst: МЫ ЖЕ ШУТИМ, ДА?! РАДИ ВСЕГО СВЯТОГО, СКАЖИ, ЧТО ЭТО ШУТКА!
The Shadow of the Beast#024.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#025.src: WHAT IS THIS?! ARE YOU BRAINDEAD?!
The Shadow of the Beast#025.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#026.src: NO, WAIT, YOU'RE HUMAN, THAT'S THE PROBLEM! IDIOT THUGS, ALL OF YOU!
The Shadow of the Beast#026.dst: НЕТ, ТЫ ЖЕ ЧЕЛОВЕК, В ТОМ И БЕДА! ТУПЫЕ БАНДИТЫ, ВСЕ ВЫ!
The Shadow of the Beast#026.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#027.src: DID I NEED TO SPECIFY THAT I WANTED THEM BACK ALIVE? WAS THAT NOT OBVIOUS TO YOU?!
The Shadow of the Beast#027.dst: НАДО БЫЛО УТОЧНИТЬ, ЧТО ОНИ НУЖНЫ ЖИВЫМИ? ЭТО ЧТО, НЕ ОЧЕВИДНО?!
The Shadow of the Beast#027.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#028.src: Hff...haah...hrrgh...I...I can't bellevue...bellevue? Believe! I can't believe this!
The Shadow of the Beast#028.dst: Хфф...хаа...я...не могу поверх...поверхность? Поверить! Не верю!
The Shadow of the Beast#028.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#029.src: Uff, settle down, Tolem, settle down...you can still salvage this...
The Shadow of the Beast#029.dst: Уф, спокойно, Tolem, спокойно... это ещё можно спасти...
The Shadow of the Beast#029.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#030.src: Alright, two things. Your new name is Idiot, and I'm changing our deal. You owe me [{~} Willow Planks].
The Shadow of the Beast#030.dst: Так, две вещи. Теперь тебя зовут Идиот, и я меняю уговор. С тебя [{~} Willow Planks].
The Shadow of the Beast#030.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#031.src: You're going to help me get at least one thing around here working. You get the wood, I'll keep looking over the fencing.
The Shadow of the Beast#031.dst: Поможешь наладить тут хоть что-то. Ты несёшь дерево, а я дальше разбираюсь с забором.
The Shadow of the Beast#031.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#033.src: Oh lovely. Idiot's back! Joy of joys. Willow planks, please.
The Shadow of the Beast#033.dst: О, прелесть. Идиот вернулся! Счастье-то. Доски Willow, давай.
The Shadow of the Beast#033.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#034.src: Good. Even if you've got murder on the mind constantly, you have decent woodcutting arms.
The Shadow of the Beast#034.dst: Хорошо. Пусть у тебя на уме одни убийства, но руки для рубки леса годные.
The Shadow of the Beast#034.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#035.src: I'll sell the remainder of these planks to try and recoup the money for my cows you mulched.
The Shadow of the Beast#035.dst: Остаток досок продам, чтобы отбить деньги за коров, ставших по твоей милости фаршем.
The Shadow of the Beast#035.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#036.src: So go on, get out of here now. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
The Shadow of the Beast#036.dst: Ну всё, иди уже. Займись делом и иди по огромным следам на земле. Охоться на то, на что НАДО, а не на скот!
The Shadow of the Beast#036.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#037.src: Go on, get out of here. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
The Shadow of the Beast#037.dst: Давай, уходи. Займись делом и иди по огромным следам на земле. Охоться на то, на что НАДО, а не на скот!
The Shadow of the Beast#037.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#038.src: Follow the footprints from Tolem's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Shadow of the Beast#038.dst: Иди по следам от дома Tolem на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#039.src: Oh, I'll never be able to fix this with my back in this state...
The Shadow of the Beast#039.dst: Ох, с моей-то спиной мне этого ни в жизнь не починить...
The Shadow of the Beast#039.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#041.src: Oh, look at this...all my years of carpentry and my bad back does my poor house in.
The Shadow of the Beast#041.dst: Ох, гляньте... всю жизнь плотничаю, а больная спина сгубила мой бедный дом.
The Shadow of the Beast#041.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#042.src: What on earth could have done this?! It must be the biggest beast in the swamp!
The Shadow of the Beast#042.dst: Кто же мог такое натворить?! Не иначе самый большой зверь болота!
The Shadow of the Beast#042.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#043.src: I was just sitting inside having some dinner, I hear some rumbling, and suddenly my house is falling apart!
The Shadow of the Beast#043.dst: Сижу я дома, ужинаю, слышу грохот - и вдруг дом разваливается!
The Shadow of the Beast#043.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#044.src: You human folk are good with physical labor, I hear? Do you think you could help me out here?
The Shadow of the Beast#044.dst: Говорят, вы, люди, горазды на тяжёлую работу? Не поможете мне тут?
The Shadow of the Beast#044.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#045.src: There's a mine just over there. Think you can get [{~} Cobblestone] out of it?
The Shadow of the Beast#045.dst: Там рядом шахта. Сможете добыть оттуда [{~} Cobblestone]?
The Shadow of the Beast#045.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#046.src: I'll go find someone who's selling any spare wood for the roof...
The Shadow of the Beast#046.dst: А я пойду поищу, кто продаст лишних досок на крышу...
The Shadow of the Beast#046.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#047.src: Think you could help fix my house? You'll need [{~} Cobblestone] to do it.
The Shadow of the Beast#047.dst: Поможете починить мой дом? Понадобится [{~} Cobblestone].
The Shadow of the Beast#047.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#048.src: Enter Kroac's mine and gather [{~} Cobblestone].
The Shadow of the Beast#048.dst: Войди в шахту Kroac и собери [{~} Cobblestone].

The Shadow of the Beast#049.src: Did you get enough cobblestone? I found a guy down the street selling this top-quality Willow...
The Shadow of the Beast#049.dst: Булыжника хватило? Я нашёл на улице мужика, продаёт отменную Willow...
The Shadow of the Beast#049.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#050.src: Good, perfect. That should be enough. Though, I do have one other thing to ask you, soldier.
The Shadow of the Beast#050.dst: Хорошо, отлично. Этого должно хватить. Но, солдат, есть у меня к вам ещё одна просьба.
The Shadow of the Beast#050.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#051.src: My back's already screaming at me just from lugging the wood over here, there's no way I can climb up there and fix the roof like this.
The Shadow of the Beast#051.dst: Спина и так воет после того, как я дотащил сюда доски. Так мне ни за что не залезть наверх чинить крышу.
The Shadow of the Beast#051.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#052.src: I can compensate you for the trouble, but d'you think you could do some patchwork for me with that cobble?
The Shadow of the Beast#052.dst: Я возмещу хлопоты, но не залатаете ли вы мне крышу этим булыжником?
The Shadow of the Beast#052.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#053.src: Oh, you're a saint. Can't imagine why the guy was grumbling about humans... Just climb right on up the ladder!
The Shadow of the Beast#053.dst: Ох, вы просто ангел. Не пойму, чего тот тип ворчал на людей... Лезьте прямо по лестнице!
The Shadow of the Beast#053.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#054.src: Repair Kroac's house using the cobblestone from the mine.
The Shadow of the Beast#054.dst: Почини дом Kroac булыжником из шахты.

The Shadow of the Beast#055.src: I'm sorry, but your patchjob fell apart. You'll need something like {~} cobblestone to help fix this.
The Shadow of the Beast#055.dst: Простите, но ваша заплата развалилась. Нужно около {~} шт. булыжника, чтобы починить.
The Shadow of the Beast#055.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#056.src: That'll do just fine, kind soldier! You're a lifesaver, really, you are.
The Shadow of the Beast#056.dst: Вот так в самый раз, добрый солдат! Вы просто спаситель!
The Shadow of the Beast#056.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#057.src: Wait, you're going after the thing that did this? Really?! Fantastic! That's a load off my mind.
The Shadow of the Beast#057.dst: Стойте, вы идёте за тем, кто это сделал? Правда?! Чудесно! Прямо камень с души.
The Shadow of the Beast#057.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#058.src: Look's like there's tracks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
The Shadow of the Beast#058.dst: Похоже, на восток ведут следы... большие следы. Удачи в погоне, берегите себя!
The Shadow of the Beast#058.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#059.src: If you are done fixing my house, it looks like there're tacks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
The Shadow of the Beast#059.dst: Если с домом покончено, то на восток, похоже, ведут следы... большие следы. Удачи в погоне, берегите себя!
The Shadow of the Beast#059.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#060.src: Keep following the tracks of the beast.

The Shadow of the Beast#061.src: EVERYONE, MOVE! THE BEAST IS ON A RAMPAGE!
The Shadow of the Beast#061.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#062.src: Aah, no! There were people in that house!
The Shadow of the Beast#062.dst: Ах, нет! В том доме были люди!
The Shadow of the Beast#062.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#063.src: Wah! H-Human! Get away, there's nothing you can help with here!
The Shadow of the Beast#063.dst: Ва! Ч-человек! Уходи, тут тебе нечем помочь!
The Shadow of the Beast#063.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#064.src: All your type does is break and hurt! You have more in common with the giant there than any of us!
The Shadow of the Beast#064.dst: Вы только ломаете и калечите! У тебя с тем великаном больше общего, чем с любым из нас!
The Shadow of the Beast#064.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#065.src: Aah, there's so many people hurt already, don't make it worse please!
The Shadow of the Beast#065.dst: А-а, раненых и так полно, не делай хуже, прошу!
The Shadow of the Beast#065.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#066.src: We don't even have any medicine...
The Shadow of the Beast#066.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#067.src: Ugh, think Rileen! You have the herbs, what else goes into the poultices...
The Shadow of the Beast#067.dst: Ох, думай, Rileen! Травы есть, что ещё идёт в припарки...
The Shadow of the Beast#067.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#068.src: Oh, right! Fish oil...but I don't have a rod, gah!
The Shadow of the Beast#068.dst: А, точно! Рыбий жир... но у меня нет удочки, ах!
The Shadow of the Beast#068.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#069.src: There's no way I can get [{~} Salmon Oil], even if that pond out back is teeming with fish...
The Shadow of the Beast#069.dst: Мне никак не добыть [{~} Salmon Oil], хоть в пруду за домом рыбы полно...
The Shadow of the Beast#069.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#071.src: No, there's no time to make a fishing spear- AAH! You're still here? What do you WANT?!
The Shadow of the Beast#071.dst: Нет, некогда делать острогу- А-А! Ты всё ещё тут? Чего тебе НАДО?!
The Shadow of the Beast#071.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#072.src: W-wait, what's...is this... This is salmon oil! Ten bottles of it! You...you heard me talking?
The Shadow of the Beast#072.dst: П-погоди, что... это... Это жир лосося! Десять бутылок! Тебе... было слышно, о чём я?
The Shadow of the Beast#072.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#073.src: And you went out of your way to... What kind of a human are you? I've only ever heard horror stories about your kind.
The Shadow of the Beast#073.dst: И ты ради этого... Что ты за человек такой? Про вас я слышала одни страшилки.
The Shadow of the Beast#073.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#075.src: ...maybe you're not so bad. I don't have anything that I can give you in return, but thank you, still.
The Shadow of the Beast#075.dst: ...может, с тобой не всё так плохо. Мне нечем отплатить, но всё равно спасибо.
The Shadow of the Beast#075.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#076.src: Wait, you were chasing the giant? That's why you were here? That...that's amazing news!
The Shadow of the Beast#076.dst: Стой, ты идёшь по следу великана? Поэтому ты здесь? Это... это чудесная новость!
The Shadow of the Beast#076.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#077.src: I think it went into the cave east of here. Go for it! Stop that thing before it causes any more damage!
The Shadow of the Beast#077.dst: Вроде он ушёл в пещеру к востоку. Вперёд! Останови его, пока он не натворил бед!
The Shadow of the Beast#077.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#078.src: Find the cave of the beast by following the footprints behind Rileen's house.
The Shadow of the Beast#078.dst: Найди пещеру зверя, идя по следам за домом Rileen.

The Shadow of the Beast#079.src: Kill the beast and return to Dereg with proof of its death at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Shadow of the Beast#079.dst: Убей зверя и вернись к Dereg с доказательством его смерти на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#080.src: You're back! Any luck hunting the thing down?
The Shadow of the Beast#080.dst: О, ты тут! Ну как, выследить тварь удалось?
The Shadow of the Beast#080.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#081.src: What? You actually found the beast?! Heck of a hunting job, human!
The Shadow of the Beast#081.dst: Что? Зверь правда найден?! Вот это охота, человек!
The Shadow of the Beast#081.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#082.src: You wouldn't be back here if you didn't manage to kill it...which means our problems are solved, right?
The Shadow of the Beast#082.dst: Не убей ты его, тебя бы тут не было... значит, наши беды позади, да?
The Shadow of the Beast#082.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#083.src: Heheh! That bone powder looks giant enough to me! Great job, bucko!
The Shadow of the Beast#083.dst: Хе-хе! Костная мука вполне великанская! Отлично, дружище!
The Shadow of the Beast#083.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#084.src: Y'know, come to think of it, I remember something that might be interesting to your sort.
The Shadow of the Beast#084.dst: Знаешь, раз уж на то пошло, я вспомнил кое-что, что может заинтересовать таких, как ты.
The Shadow of the Beast#084.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#085.src: The weapon merchant in {p} researches cryptids as a hobby, and that beast seemed one-of-a-kind to me.
The Shadow of the Beast#085.dst: Оружейник в {p} на досуге изучает криптидов, а зверь-то, по-моему, единственный такой.
The Shadow of the Beast#085.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#086.src: You should show him that bone powder! He might have some good gear for you.
The Shadow of the Beast#086.dst: Покажи ему костную муку! Вдруг даст тебе хорошее снаряжение.
The Shadow of the Beast#086.speaker: Dereg
